conclusion.established_in_fixture: the confidence verifier distinguishes stochasticity from missing memory, repairs order one to order two, confidence-clusters four contexts into two approximately predictive blocks, and dynamic repair restores four autonomous states
conclusion.negative_findings: weak signals inside the hysteresis band remain unresolved; drift invalidates stationary certification; adaptive prediction matches rather than exceeds the correctly specified fixed-order-two baseline
conclusion.next_falsifiable_experiment: introduce actions and let the verifier select interventions that maximise expected reduction in representation uncertainty under a budget
conclusion.not_established: general hidden-state identification, arbitrary dependent noise, continuous observations, language acquisition, or superiority to modern neural sequence models

experiment.question: Can observation-only repair distinguish stochastic variation from missing state, wait under insufficient evidence, reject distribution drift, and recover an approximately predictive but dynamically closed finite interface?

mathematical_contract.merge_certificate: if |p_hat_i-p_hat_j|+r_i+r_j <= epsilon_merge, then on the simultaneous coverage event |p_i-p_j| <= epsilon_merge
mathematical_contract.proof_boundary: the probability statement follows from Hoeffding and a finite union bound under the fixture's conditional-independence assumption; Monte Carlo is an implementation stress test, not the proof
mathematical_contract.simultaneous_bound: for every declared Bernoulli cell i with n_i observations, |p_hat_i-p_i| <= sqrt(log(2M/delta)/(2n_i)) simultaneously with probability at least 1-delta
mathematical_contract.split_certificate: if |p_hat_i-p_hat_j|-r_i-r_j > epsilon_split, then on the simultaneous coverage event |p_i-p_j| > epsilon_split
mathematical_contract.stationarity_policy: compare context laws across chronological episode halves and reject a stationary quotient when a split certificate fires
mathematical_contract.uncertainty_policy: when neither certificate fires, acquire the next declared batch; at budget exhaustion abstain

selected_interval_coverage.boundary: empirical coverage of selected context intervals, not a replacement for the Hoeffding guarantee

confidence_contract.adaptive_validity_boundary: the batch schedule and finite query family are declared in advance; the union bound covers every possible queried cell-stage pair
confidence_contract.fixture_assumption: conditional on a context visit, each next bit uses an independent Bernoulli innovation with a stationary context law
confidence_contract.inequality: two-sided Hoeffding plus finite union bound
